company.name: Al Basateen Al Amrah International Trade Investment
company.shortDescription: Al Basateen Al Amrah International Trade Investment is an international trading company working in the agricultural sector.
company.description:
Al Basateen Al Amrah is an Omani-based agricultural innovation company dedicated to food security, sustainability, and rural revitalization. We look to specialize in hydroponic fodder production and vertical greenhouse farming, using advanced climate-resilient technologies to grow high-yield crops and nutritious livestock feed with minimal water and land usage.

Rooted in purpose and aligned with Oman Vision 2040, our mission is to transform underutilized farmlands into productive, regenerative Agri-hubs that support local farmers, reduce food imports, and contribute to national self-sufficiency.
